lines.text: Many learners say: I use glasses every day.
Better: I wear glasses every day.
We wear glasses on our face.
Wear! I wear a hat in winter.

data.why: We wear glasses on our face.

native.tip: 한국어 “쓰다”는 ‘글을 쓰다·사용하다·착용하다’를 모두 뜻해서 use로 옮기기 쉬워요. 안경을 착용할 땐 wear예요!
native.caption: “I use glasses every day.”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어 “쓰다”는 “글을 쓰다·사용하다·안경을 쓰다”처럼 뜻이 넓어서 use로 옮기기 쉬워요. 안경은 wear를 써요. “I wear glasses every day”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “wear”. 안경과 모자엔 wear! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Korean “sseuda” means write, use and wear, so people say use. English says wear. Say “I wear glasses every day”.
en.caption: Do you say “I use glasses every day”? 😅 For glasses, use wear, not use. “I wear glasses every day” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
